# Never commit these. They are rebuilt from package.json by `npm install`,
# they are 9,000+ files / ~180 MB, and they contain platform-specific binaries
# (Windows builds would break the deploy on Vercel/Linux).

.pnpm-store/

# ---------- build output ----------
# Generated by `npm run build`. Vercel/Netlify build it for you.
dist/
dist-ssr/
build/
*.local

# ---------- secrets — NEVER commit these ----------
# .env holds your PayHere merchant id / Sheet key / Stripe key.
.env
.env.*
# ...but the template is meant to be shared:
!.env.example

# ---------- logs ----------
*.log
npm-debug.log*
yarn-debug.log*
